title: Run retry should preserve failed run context for diagnosis
description: When a run fails and is retried, the partial run state — tool errors, signals emitted mid-run, and the point of failure — is not persisted before the retry begins. This means recurring failures (e.g. missing frontmatter, patch errors) cannot be distinguished from first-time failures, and the agent retrying has no access to what was already attempted.
proposed_resolution: Before initiating a retry, persist the current run state to the run file with a status of failed and a failure_reason field. On retry, load the prior failed run file and pass its tool_errors and signals to the agent as context so it can avoid repeating the same mistake. The retried run should reference the failed run via a retried_from_run_id field.
